steps.description: Identify the sports and matches relevant to the birthday party theme for which predictions are needed.
Gather current data and statistics related to the identified sports matches to support accurate predictions.
Generate accurate predictions for the identified sports matches using the gathered data.
Compile the predictions into a format suitable for presentation at the sports-themed birthday party.
